candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces and logs show the gateway's client call to order:8000 failing with 500 across all correlated requests, so the checkout 502 is a propagated downstream server error originating in the order service.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within order (db, payment, inventory) not established; order-side logs/metrics absent.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s are consistently caused by the order service returning 500 on POST /v1/orders, as shown by correlated traces and gateway client logs. The proximate fault is bounded to the order service; the specific internal cause (db-pool, payment, inventory) is not yet evidenced, so only the http-500 candidate is asserted.
